page.layout: One column of running text. Small marginal notes in the left margin, partly cut off, and a few lines of small fragments at the bottom left. Running head at the top with the page number to its left. Nothing in the right margin.

main_text.p: censu habebant, devênit. Reliquus ordo magistratuum, senatus utriusque & judiciorum civitati relictus. Sed imperatum, ut oratores rebus Macedonicis infesti Antipatro traderentur. Quorum principes Demosthenes & Hyperides sibi metuentes in fugam se dederunt. Hyperides in Æginà cum aliis interceptus, & è templo abreptus ductusque Corinthum ad Antipatrum crudeliter ab eo habitus & interemptus est. Demosthenes in insulà Calauriâ ad aram Neptuni sedens, ne in manus Macedonum deveniret, hausto veneno semet peremit. Quadriennio post extincto Antipatro,& dissidentibus inter se Cassandro Antipatri filio, & Polyperchonte, quem Antipater successorem sibi in præfecturà Macedoniæ ediderat, fluctuavit rursum status Athenienstum.[illegible, ~4 letters] Nam ob Polyperchontem, qui libertatis Græcorum patronum se profitebatur, præsidiaque locis munitis educi per[illegible, ~3 letters] ictum[?] præcipiebat, populares in urbe animos erexerunt: cæteri in Cassandrum Munychiam præsidio tenentem præcipiebant[?]. Interea Nicanor Muny-iæ pro Cassandro præfectus, populo poscente, ut præsidium inde abduceret, solum id non fecit, sed Piræum quoque furtim occupavit: quod toti ci-[illegible, ~5 letters]vitati

page.notes: The left margin carries several short marginal notes, mostly cut off or too faint to read; they are marked as illegible where they stand. The bottom-left fragments are unreadable and are not transcribed beyond these markers. The word before "piciebant" at the start of its line is partly hidden, so "præcipiebant" is conjectural. "ictum" after "educi per" is doubtful. The text is continuous with no clear indent, so it is kept as one paragraph continuing from the previous page.
